credits_text:
Sirius Pictures present
introducing Jenni Young as "Morticia"
a film by Nabil Shaban
other_text:
"tough themes and messages...wrapped up in a really entertaining way...beautiful and really haunting music..." - BBI
"...Morticia embodies the use of honesty, integrity, surprise...and her ability to present a variety of types in a way that encourages thought and discussion..." - Ohio Herald
"viewers familiar with Nabil Shaban's work will not be at all surprised to find doubts and ambiguities lurking beneath the surface."
description: A poster shows a woman sitting on a gravestone in a cemetery, with text introducing the film 'Morticia' directed by Nabil Shaban.
